# ConverterForAll

> 100% Private File Converter — Process Documents & Media Entirely on Your Device

ConverterForAll is a suite of entirely client-side, serverless conversion tools built with WebAssembly. No user files are ever uploaded to a server, ensuring complete privacy and fast processing times.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://converterforall.com/): Browse all conversion tools starting from the homepage.
- [Blog](https://converterforall.com/blog/): Articles and guides on file conversion and privacy.
- [Sitemap](https://converterforall.com/sitemap.xml): The XML sitemap for the entire website.

## Optional Details

All tools operate entirely on the client-side within the user's browser using Web Workers and WebAssembly. There are no backend APIs for file conversions. To understand the privacy implications: no files ever leave the user's device.
